Our goal is to redefine the skills section on everyone's resume and become the global gold standard in skill measurement.

name: Snowball
about: Snowball makes it easier to keep track of all of your conversations by showing messages from your favorite social apps in one place.

name: Sold
about: Sold is a new mobile service that reinvents the selling process for online marketplaces. Sold makes selling easy through smart pricing analytics and a refined user experience.

name: Spring
about: Spring is an e-commerce platform that makes mobile shopping easier.

name: Spruce
about: Spruce makes personalized dermatology care accessible through a mobile app that allows users to make appointments, see their doctors, and view individualized care plans.

name: Stamped
about: Stamped is a new way for friends to put their stamp of approval on only what they like best - restaurants, books, movies, music, and more. Everyone gets a limited number of stamps to start, and can earn more if their friends like what they recommend. The result is a new source of quality information that is curated by trusted friends. (Stamped was acquired by Yahoo in October 2012.)

name: Stitch
about: Stitch is a mobile email app that allows salespeople to be as effective and responsive on the go as when sitting in front of a desk.

name: Subtext
about: Subtext is a digital reading company with a vision to power the largest community of readers, authors, and experts in the pages of ebooks. The service's social networking and enrichment features lay over standard ebooks to transform reading into a social activity and connect books to the Web. (Subtext was acquired by Renaissance Learning in June 2013.)

name: SweetLabs
about: SweetLabs empowers developers to offer a compelling application experience through two unique platforms: Pokki and the OpenCandy Software Network. Pokki is an application platform that brings media-rich HTML5 web apps to the desktop, and the OpenCandy Software Network offers software recommendations through the download and installation process.

name: Swell
about: Swell provides instant access to streaming audio news and information. Over time, it personalizes your stream with content based on your preferences and the wisdom of the community.

name: Synack
about: Synack is redefining the traditional model of security testing with technology that allows customers to safely engage a global, on-demand community of trusted security researchers. Synack’s scalable platform enables rapid and efficient vulnerability discovery.

name: SynapDx
about: SynapDx is developing a blood test to enable earlier diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorders.

name: Tamr
about: Tamr is a data connection platform that dramatically reduces the time and effort required to connect and enrich data sources allowing data scientists, analysts, and managers to focus on data-driven innovation.

name: tenXer
about: tenXer is a personal productivity service designed to revolutionize human capital management by combining performance data with social and game-like motivation systems. tenXer makes work better and your work better.

name: The Climate Corporation
about: The Climate Corporation helps people and businesses adapt to climate change through technologically advanced weather insurance products. (The Climate Corporation was acquired by Monsanto in November 2013)

name: The Orange Chef Co.
about: The Orange Chef is creating a smarter kitchen through connected devices, including a smart food scale that visualizes nutrition.

name: ThinkNear
about: ThinkNear helps local merchants increase profitability with a yield management solution. The product requires no hardware, takes under 5 minutes to set-up, and runs in the background, continuously getting smarter about which discounts and channels to use to keep merchants as busy as possible at all times. (ThinkNear was acquired by Telenav in October 2012.)

name: ThreatStream
about: ThreatStream is a threat intelligence platform that uses data science to help organizations defend against cyberattacks.

name: Tracelytics
about: Tracelytics provides next-generation application performance management (APM) software as a service. Tracelytics' solution offers customers insight into the performance of their web applications, revealing what's going wrong and what could be done better. (Exited portfolio in June 2012.)

name: Trada
about: Trada is the only crowdsourced, performance-based advertising marketplace where a community of certified advertising experts build, manage and optimize advertisers' search marketing and Facebook campaigns. Multiple experts work on each campaign, bringing diverse strategies and creative ideas that no individual or software program could produce.

name: Transcriptic
about: Transcriptic is a biotech company developing next-generation lab automation and virtualization technology.

name: Transphorm
about: Transphorm makes ultra-efficient power modules that eliminate up to 90% of all electric conversion losses. From HVACs to hybrids; servers to solar panels – Transphorm enables significant energy savings across the grid.

name: TrueLens
about: TrueLens develops solutions for marketers to better target customers by interests and intent using social media data.

name: TuneIn
about: TuneIn is a free service that lets people listen to music, sports, and news from around the world. TuneIn offers over 70,000 stations and 2 million on-demand programs, making it easy for people to listen to what they love.

name: Turo
about: Turo is a car rental marketplace where travelers can rent any car they want, wherever they want it, from a nationwide community of local car owners.

name: Uber
about: Uber is evolving the way the world moves. By seamlessly connecting riders to drivers through mobile apps, they make cities more accessible, opening up more possibilities for riders and more business for drivers.

name: UberConference
about: UberConference does conference calls, better. Their visual interface lets you see who's on the call, link to social profiles, mute participants, and even skip PINs.

name: UberSense
about: UberSense is creating a smart software solution that helps athletes achieve their full athletic ability using video and collaboration.

name: Unbabel
about: Unbabel is a human corrected machine translation service to help businesses communicate with customers globally.

name: Upstart
about: Upstart is an online lending platform that goes beyond the FICO score to finance people based on signals of their potential, including schools attended, area of study, academic performance, and work history. Their proprietary underwriting model identifies high quality borrowers despite limited credit and employment experience.

name: Upthere
about: Upthere is building the future of the cloud.

name: Urban Engines
about: Urban Engines reduces congestion by combining insights and incentives to ease the time and stress of daily commutes.

name: URX
about: URX creates product ads for mobile apps, enabling advertisers to link directly to product pages in their mobile apps.

name: VIDA
about: VIDA is an online retail store of exclusive apparel designed by a partnership of designers, artists, and makers from around the world.

name: VigLink
about: VigLink is a tool for publishers of all sizes to make monetization of their outbound links effortless, transparent, and honest.

name: Vungle
about: Vungle helps mobile app developers promote their apps through video trailers.

name: Walker and Company
about: Walker and Company makes health and beauty products for people of color.

name: Wander
about: Wander is a beautiful way to share and experience the world.

name: Wearable Intelligence
about: Wearable Intelligence is helping service workers go hands-free by providing enterprise solutions for wearable technology, including Google Glass.

name: Weotta
about: Weotta helps you discover, build, and share your infinite wish list of things to do and places to go.

name: Wingu
about: Wingu envisioned and is developing the first Research Intelligence solution designed to increase the operational efficiency of outsourced and distributed R&D in the pharmaceutical industry.

name: WUT
about: WUT is a mobile app for sharing ephemeral messages with friends anonymously.

name: Yesware
about: Yesware helps salespeople close more deals faster. The company provides services in Gmail, on mobile phones, and beyond to improve sales efficiency and effectiveness.

name: Yieldify
about: Yieldify specializes in customer conversion, helping digital marketers predict, adapt to, and measure their visitors' email and on site behavior.

name: Yieldmo
about: Yieldmo is rethinking mobile advertising to optimize yield for publishers, ROI for marketers, and the experience for consumers.

name: Zencoder
about: Zencoder offers high-performance video encoding as a service in the cloud. Zencoder is also the creator of VideoJS, the leading open-source HTML5 video player. (Zencoder was acquired by Brightcove in July 2012.)

name: ZenPayroll
about: ZenPayroll provides a modern cloud-based payroll service that is simple and delightful to use.

name: Zephyr Health
about: Zephyr Health provides insights-as-a-service, harnessing the power of global health data to address critical business and patient needs.
